english.title: Recklessly provide false / misleading information to another for the CMA for a Part 1 function of Competition Act 1998
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowing that information was to be used for the purpose of providing information to the CMA in connection with any of its functions under Part I of the Competition Act 1998 recklessly provided the information to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), which was false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MATERIAL PARTICULAR..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section44(2)(b) and (3) of the Competition Act 1998.

english.notes: A person does not commit this offence by reason of any act or omission in relation to which the Competition and Markets Authority has proceeded by issuing a civil penalty under section 40ZE(1) of the Competition Act 1998, see section 44(2A).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
